description: TXN-MULTI, two Workspaces in opposite file order on rows that do not share a page (the first card's second file had three rows on one page and refused one update). Workspace w1 opens main (A) then wide2 (B); w2 opens B then A. Both BeginTrans; w1 updates V of A row 1 and then B row 1; w2 updates V of B row 64 and then A row 64 (Errors before/after, unindexed field V). Phase 1: w1 Rollback then w2 CommitTrans; phase 2: w2 CommitTrans then w1 CommitTrans; phase 3: w2 Rollback then w1 CommitTrans. A third Workspace reads all four rows after a pause and Idle. Asks whether participant order matters and whether each Workspace's resolution covers both files.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
